Place Daisy's House in the Valley.

Add one of your creations to a Boutique mannequin or furniture pedestal so visitors from other Valleys can buy it.

(Remember: Dress mannequins and pedestals on the Boutique's main floor, not the ones in the elevated corner area.)

Umístěte jeden ze svých výtvorů na figurínu nebo podstavec pro nábytek v Modním salonu, aby si ho mohli koupit návštěvníci z jiných údolí.

Place furniture for the Boutique Challenge by selecting {input_inventory}, navigating to the Furniture menu, and decorating in the Challenge Space corner of the Boutique.

Interact with the mannequins in the Challenge Space corner to add clothing to them.
